If you do ONE thing this week to improve your AI visibility, add these 5 schema types to your website:

LOCAL SEO (Google Maps): Google Business Profile with photos → NAP consistency → Local citations → Customer reviews. Goal: Rank in the Local Pack (top 3 map results).

AI-READY (ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity): LocalBusiness schema with geo-coordinates → FAQ schema about local services → AI-readable content with clear entity signals → Fresh, updated content monthly → Third-party mentions (reviews, news, Reddit). Goal: Get cited as a recommendation.
